newFeatures: Smart Install: Update now automatically installs into a new versioned folder (e.g. Edu-track v1.1.5) instead of overwriting the old one
Multi-Browser WhatsApp Support: Auto-detects Chrome, Edge, and Brave — or lets you pick a custom browser path
Shortcut Auto-Update: Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts are automatically repointed to the new version after update
improvements: App data, database, and WhatsApp sessions are seamlessly migrated to the new versioned folder during update
Old version folder is cleanly removed after a successful update — no leftover clutter
Google OAuth now uses a secure local loopback server, eliminating the 'Error 400: invalid_request' on sync
App no longer triggers First-Time Setup when launched from a temporary folder during update
bugFixes: Fixed app startup delay caused by WhatsApp browser detection searching a single hard-coded Chrome path
Fixed Setup Wizard appearing after every update due to incorrect data directory detection
Fixed Google OAuth login failing with Error 400 invalid_request
futureFeatures: Advanced Student Performance & Grade Analytics Dashboard
Parent Online Portal for live attendance & grades
